name: Saff Loom
summary: Two broad offset arches interlock: the mosque rib crosses a warm prayer-rug frame that continues to the ground.
why: The ivory mosque arch is centered on x=54 and joined to its minaret. The warm rug arch is centered on x=59 and crosses the first arch at its shoulder; the ivory right pier passes over it again at y=60 to 66. The rug sides continue from that interlock into a widened, flat prayer surface at y=80. Each arch has its own exact axis and deliberately asymmetric placement.
risk: The rug is expressed as an architectural weave rather than a literal carpet illustration. At 24px the paired colors and open archway carry the idea; the interlock is clearer at 48px.
sub1: Structure and prayer joined in one contour
sub2: A continuous path from mosque to prayer
reasonToChoose: You want a distinctive woven mark connecting mosque architecture and a place for prayer.
